text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon. I spotted Victoire Pisa 
near the hollow of the great tree.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Mr. Starling, Mr. Sparrow. ...Is 
something the matter? Staying all the way 
over there...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, I'm making you worry about 
me, aren't I? You can tell that I'm 
completely overwhelmed..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If I stay here, I feel I might disrupt 
your circle's harmony... I shall take my 
leave for today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa walked away, her shoulders 
slumped. It seems fatigue has caught up 
with her. I should reconsider her race 
schedule...
